Params.Cmd: ip -4 -o addr show wlan0 | awk '{print $4}' | cut -d/ -f1

dumpsys media_session | awk '/state=PlaybackState \{state=PLAYING/{p=1;next} p&&/metadata:/{sub(/.*description=/,"");n=split($0,a,", ");f=1;if(n>=2&&a[2]!="null")print a[2]" - "a[1];else print a[1];exit} END{if(!f)print "nothing playing"}'

f=$(cat /sys/devices/platform/34f00000.gpu0/devfreq/*/cur_freq); sudo sh -c 'dumpsys gpu | awk "/^Proc [0-9]+ total/{print \$4, \$2}" | sort -rn | head -3 | while read b p; do n=$(tr "\0" "\n" < /proc/$p/cmdline | head -1); echo "${n##*/} $((b/1048576))M"; done' | paste -sd, - | sed 's/,/, /g' | { read t; echo "GPU $((f/1000000)) MHz | $t"; }
